description: This file defines API routes related to authentication in a FastAPI application, including user signup, login, and fetching current user info. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy models and dependencies, and uses security utilities for token management and password handling.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user in the system

methods.name: TokenResponse signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating a new user in the database and returning an access token.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning an access token if successful.

methods.name: UserOut me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignupRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/
